type: concept comparison board; not yet applied to application
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished design exploration presentation board for a Chinese Windows television live-viewing application named “鲸鱼电视”. Wide landscape board, tasteful warm off-white background, restrained modern brand design, generous space. Header top left exact Chinese “鲸鱼电视”, small subtitle “应用图标设计”. Three equally sized columns labeled “A 屏幕鲸”, “B 轻盈鲸”, “C 鲸尾视窗”. Each column shows one large square app icon and below it two small repeats of that same icon demonstrating small-size legibility, plus a flat single-color silhouette of that column's mark. This is a concept comparison board, not executable UI.
All icons use deep midnight navy rounded-square tiles with ice-blue / pale-white marks, exceptionally clean smooth vector-like geometry, bold recognizable silhouettes, no gradients or subtle shadows required, no 3D mockup, no lettering within tiles. Adult-friendly, friendly yet refined, not a childish mascot. Avoid resemblance to Docker containers, streaming company marks or existing brand logos.
A (recommended visual priority): a minimal whale body forms a rounded television screen outline, big gently rectangular body on left, small elegant two-fluke tail extending right, one single small eye integrated on upper-left of body, substantial navy inner screen negative space. Whale and TV must be one unified ingenious shape, NOT separate whale placed on a TV. Clear at 24px.
B: solid ice-blue simplified swimming whale, curved rectangular body, small white screen-shaped negative-space cutout inside body, tail curves slightly upward. Distinct from A but equally minimal.
C: a soft rectangular ice-blue screen outline with a small whale tail integrated into the upper-right corner; a restrained tiny eye optional if it improves recognition. The most architectural and compact mark.
No play triangles, no antennas, no water spout, no ocean waves, no multiple dots, no decorative bubbles, no tiny intricate details. Typography crisp accurate Chinese, minimal text only the specified header/subtitle and labels. Consistent tile corner radii and visual scale. Present a sophisticated designer's comparison sheet that lets the user choose a direction.
